game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against blizzard sprites. Each round, a new flint stones challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of flint stones by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Ice Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
